values.zh: 显示当前药瓶路径的切线方向；需要同时开启“路径曲线”才会实际渲染。
values.en: Shows the tangent direction of the current potion path. Requires Path Curve to be enabled before it is rendered.

values.zh: 显示加水后药瓶会移动的方向。
values.en: Shows the direction the potion bottle will move after adding water.

values.zh: 显示目标效果中心到当前药瓶位置的径向参考线。
values.en: Shows a radial reference line from the target effect center to the current potion position.

values.zh: 显示目标漩涡中心到当前药瓶位置的径向参考线。
values.en: Shows a radial reference line from the target vortex center to the current potion position.

values.zh: 显示目标漩涡处的切线方向；需要同时开启“漩涡曲线”才会实际渲染。
values.en: Shows the tangent direction at the target vortex. Requires Vortex Curve to be enabled before it is rendered.

values.zh: 显示自定义方向线，并允许用自定义方向线快捷键在地图上增删或调整它们。
values.en: Shows custom direction lines and lets you add, remove, or adjust them on the map with the custom-line shortcut.

values.zh: 模拟并显示当前药瓶继续搅拌时的路径轨迹。
values.en: Simulates and shows the path the current potion will follow if stirring continues.

values.zh: 模拟并显示选中漩涡中的旋转轨迹。
values.en: Simulates and shows the rotation path inside the selected vortex.

values.zh: 显示目标效果的判定范围，并配合路径或加水方向显示最近点。
values.en: Shows the target effect range and, with path or ladle direction enabled, shows the closest point.

values.zh: 显示目标漩涡的范围，并配合路径或加水方向显示最近点。
values.en: Shows the target vortex range and, with path or ladle direction enabled, shows the closest point.

values.zh: 模拟药瓶路径、加水方向或漩涡轨迹与骷髅区的危险交会点。
values.en: Simulates dangerous intersections between the potion path, ladle direction, or vortex path and skull zones.

values.zh: 模拟路径轨迹与沼泽区的交会位置和距离。
values.en: Simulates the intersection positions and distance between the path curve and swamp zones.

values.zh: 让药瓶指示器更透明，便于观察下方路径、范围和交会点。
values.en: Makes the potion indicator more transparent so paths, ranges, and intersections underneath are easier to see.

values.zh: 把预测点、路径线、方向线、自定义线、危险/沼泽交点以及透明瓶身参考线贴附到药瓶碰撞体位置；默认贴附到逻辑位置。
values.en: Attaches predicted points, path lines, direction lines, custom lines, danger/swamp points, and transparent-indicator reference lines to the potion collider position. Default to attach to the logic position.

values.zh: 把部分角度或血量需求换算为对应盐的用量显示。
values.en: Displays some angles or health requirements as the corresponding salt amount.

values.zh: 在信息窗口中显示当前搅拌阶段和阶段进度。
values.en: Shows the current stirring phase and phase progress in the info window.

values.zh: 把位置数据显示为半径和角度，而不是横纵坐标。
values.en: Displays positions as radius and angle instead of X and Y coordinates.
